title: Solutions Architect
description:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Customer experience:
Customer experience at Nebius AI Cloud involves tackling customers’ challenges and directly impacting their success by solving real-world AI and ML problems at massive GPU cloud scale. You’ll not only resolve issues, but play a key role in shaping clients’ business success by optimizing their AI solutions. Working with advanced GPUs such as H200, B200 and GB200, as well as modern ML frameworks, you’ll influence the development of the Nebius AI Cloud and gain experience at the intersection of infrastructure and AI. With minimal bureaucracy, you’ll have the freedom to innovate, take ownership and drive change. Opportunities for growth are abundant in this vibrant and supportive professional community.
The role
We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused professional to join our team as a Solutions Architect specializing in Cloud infrastructure and MLOps . As a Cloud Solutions Architect, you will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing cutting-edge solutions for our clients, leveraging cloud technologies for ML/AI teams and becoming a trusted technical advisor for building their pipelines.
You’re welcome to work remotely from the United States.
Your responsibilities will include:

• Act as a trusted advisor to our clients, providing technical expertise and guidance throughout the engagement. Conduct PoC, workshops, presentations, and training sessions to educate clients on GPU cloud technologies and best practices.

• Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and develop solution architecture that align with their needs: design and document Infrastructure as code solutions, documentation and technical how-tos in collaboration with support engineers and technical writers.

• Help customers to optimize pipeline performance and scalability to ensure efficient utilization of cloud resources and services powered by Nebius AI.

• Act as a single point of expertise of customer scenarios for product, technical support, marketing teams.

• Assist to Marketing department efforts during events (Hackathons, conferences, workshops, webinars, etc.)

We expect you to have:

• 5 - 10 + years of experience as a cloud solutions architect, system/network engineer, developer or a similar technical role with a focus on cloud computing

• Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with IaC and configuration management tools (preferably Terraform/Ansible), Kubernetes, skills of writing code in Python

• Solid understanding of GPU computing practices for ML training and inference workloads, GPU software stack components, including drivers, libraries (e.g. CUDA, OpenCL)

• Excellent communication skills

• Customer-centric mindset

It will be an added bonus if you have:

• Hands-on experience with HPC/ML orchestration frameworks (e.g. Slurm, Kubeflow)

• Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g. TensorFlow, PyTorch)

• Solid understanding of cloud ML tools landscape from industry leaders (NVIDIA, AWS, Azure, Google)

Key Employee Benefits:

•
Health Insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for emp

title: Assembly Integration and Test Engineer, Space Systems
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Space Manufacturing team is seeking an Assembly Integration and Test Engineer to join our team. The Space Manufacturing team is responsible for assembly, integration, and test of ground support equipment, PCBA, unit-level, and integrated systems that are vital for our aerospace and defense operations. Your expertise will help ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability at Anduril. The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership in solving a technical challenge with a creative, physical solution that they either personally manufactured or oversaw the manufacturing of, in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

• Lead and participate in system integration and test campaigns, developing test plans, test procedures, and schedules, coordinating resource needs, test equipment, and test facility needs.

• Lead test readiness reviews (TRRs) for flight hardware.

• Participate in manufacturing readiness reviews (MRRs) for flight hardware.

• Develop, document, and continuously improve processes for the manufacturing, assembly, and integration of PCBAs and box-level assemblies, and space vehicles, ensuring compliance with space-grade standards.

• Perform hands-on hardware and software testing at unit-level and system level.

• Perform detailed root cause analyses (RCA) and drive corrective actions for non-conformances/anomalies identified during integration and test.

• Specify, procure, and maintain assembly tools, fixtures, and equipment required for integration and test.

• Communicate with supply chain, hardware teams, program management, and test teams to manage priorities and resolve technical challenges.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• 5+ years of experience in aerospace, aviation, military, or other high-reliability industries, including 2+ years in hands-on integration and test of flight or comparably high-reliability hardware.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another technical discipline.

• A working, cross-disciplinary understanding of both mechanical and electrical engineering - comfortable interpreting mechanical drawings and GD&T as well as electrical schematics, troubleshooting across both mechanical hardware and electrical/electronic systems, and interfacing with design engineers to address DFM/DFA challenges.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in unit-level, space-vehicle, or system integration, assembly, and environmental testing, with direct involvement in at least 2 of: vibration, thermal vacuum, acoustic, shock, or EMI/EMC.

• Hands-on integration or test experience with electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) or comparable sensor and payload systems - at least 1 such area, and preferably more than one (e.g., EO/IR, RF/communications, or optical instruments).

• 3+ years of practical, hands-on experience using test equipment such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, and DAQs.

• 2+ years working with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and/or Material Resource Planning (MRP), including hand

title: Planner Associate
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Resumen e Impacto del Rol

La búsqueda está centrada en estudiantes de Publicidad, Comunicación o carreras afines para sumarse al equipo. Buscamos un perfil proactivo, organizado, con ganas de seguir aprendiendo, capacidad para trabajar en equipo y excelente predisposición.

Habilidades y Experiencia

• Experiencia en medios.

• Perfil proactivo y con capacidad para trabajar en equipo.

• Manejo de Excel.

Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios ( Be Extraordinary ), invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo ( Lead Optimistically ), creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo ( Championing Growth and Development ) de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto ( Create an Open Environment ) basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. Nuestro paquete integral de beneficios refleja este compromiso e incluye seguro médico, de visión y dental, planes grupales de retiro, un generoso programa de tiempo libre pagado, descuentos preferenciales con aliados y días dedicados al bienestar y la salud mental de nuestro equipo.

En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Por eso, hemos adoptado un modelo de trabajo híbrido, asistiendo a la oficina alrededor de cuatro días a la semana. Si requieres alguna adaptación o flexibilidad, te invitamos a conversarlo con el equipo de selección durante el proceso de entrevista. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad ( https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy ) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Agradecemos a todas las personas que se postulen a esta vacante; sin embargo, solo contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados para una entrevista.

 

Please read our Privacy Notice   for more information on how we process the information you provide.

Regulatory provides regulatory affairs and product development consulting services to enable pharmaceutical, medical and biotechnology companies to obtain regulatory approvals. This function applies subject matter expertise to provide services in technical writing and regulatory submissions as well as clinical research and manufacturing process consulting. Affairs plans, coordinates and implements regulatory strategies for products that require government approval. This job family proactively identifies regulatory requirements and risks for products and develops plans for product development programs and regulatory submissions.
Location: This is a remote position, and the ideal candidate will be located near or willing to travel to Waukegan, IL or Mansfield, MA.

The Principal Regulatory Affairs Specialist supports the Medical Solutions Regulatory Affairs team by managing regulatory requirements for international product registrations, developing global regulatory strategies, and supporting U.S. convenience kitting activities. The role leads regulatory efforts for new product development, manufacturing and product changes, regulatory submissions, compliance initiatives, and commercial support. Erhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.
👉 Registrieren Sie sich hier, um auf die Aufträge zuzugreifen:
DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.
Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe , um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis , Ayvens , Tesla , Volkswagen , Hertz , Avis , Europcar und viele weitere.
In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.
Worin besteht ein DriiveMe -Auftrag?
Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

• Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

• Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

• Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

• Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

• Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

• Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

• Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

• Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

• Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

• Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

• Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

Wie viel verdiene ich?
Ihr Umsatz hängt davon ab, wie viele Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.
Jeder Auftrag hat eine eigene Vergütung, die sich nach der Strecke, der Anzahl der Kilometer und der Komplexität des Transports richtet.
Bevor Sie einen Auftrag buchen, kennen Sie alle wichtigen Informationen: Abholort, Zielort, Vergütung und Bedingungen. Sie entscheiden frei, welche Aufträge Sie annehmen möchten.
Gesuchtes Profil
Um DriiveMe Partner beizutreten, sollten Sie idealerweise:

• über eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis verfügen;

• selbstständig sein oder bereit sein, selbstständig tätig zu werden;

• zuverlässig, pünktlich und sorgfältig sein;

• die Verfahren zur Abholung und Übergabe der Fahrzeuge einhalten;

• verfügbar sein, um gelegentliche Aufträge in Ihrer Region oder in anderen Teilen Deutschlands durchzuführen.

Die Registrierung der Fahrer erfolgt zentral über die offizielle DriiveMe -Seite.

Was haben wir Ihnen zu bieten?
Bei CWS -Hygiene zu arbeiten bedeutet, Teil eines dynamischen und herausfordernden Umfelds zu sein, in dem kein Tag wie der andere ist. Unsere Grundwerte: Der Kunde steht an erster Stelle, wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, werden jeden Tag besser, übernehmen Verantwortung und streben nach Erfolg.

title: Video Editor -Malayalam
description:
About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal . Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

•
Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)

•
Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony)

•
Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (Agri Lokal )

•
Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home ( Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)

•
Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app)

•
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)

•
Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (Astro Lokal )

•
Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform : local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives . We ship fast.

We learn fast. We build for Bharat. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

• Advanced English (written and spoken).

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

What You’ll Do

 

•
Develop and continuously improve risk and surveillance strategies for identifying abusive or manipulative activity across spot, perpetual futures , options, and related trading products.

•
Investigate potentially coordinated or suspicious trading activity using order-flow analysis, self-trading and crossing behaviours, order-book signals, and account-linkage indicators.

•
Define behavioural patterns for new or evolving manipulation methods, particularly in thinly traded assets, leveraged instruments, and liquidation-driven market events.

Assess the impact of identified risks, including possible market disruption, financial exposure, and concentration of risk, to inform prioritisation and leadership reporting.

Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to translate trading-risk concepts into effective detection logic, models, and monitoring workflows.

•
Practical experience trading or managing risk in derivatives, with strong knowledge of futures, perpetual swaps, and options.

•
Solid understanding of leverage, margin requirements, liquidation processes, insurance-fund structures, and auto-deleveraging mechanisms.

Demonstrated experience in trading-risk management, market surveillance, or preventing market-abuse activity such as spoofing, layering, wash trading, front-running, or misuse of privileged information.

•
Strong analytical ability; advanced SQL skills are essential, and Python experience is highly desirable.

Ability to independently create and validate detection approaches using order-level and trade-level data.

A mindset that anticipates how bad actors may build positions, obscure their behaviour, and exploit market or product mechanics.

Background in market surveillance, trading risk, or market-conduct roles at a digital-asset exchange, brokerage, or trading venue.

•
Active derivatives-trading experience or a demonstrable quantitative trading record.

•
Familiarity with conventional financial-market abuse regulations, surveillance frameworks, or vendor platforms.

•
Knowledge of blockchain analytics and on-chain transaction tracing.

•
Experience using graph analysis or entity-resolution methods to uncover coordinated account networks and fund flows.

•
Familiarity with market-quality and anomaly indicators, such as VPIN and HHI.

The Stripe Marketing organization is undergoing a fundamental transformation in how it works. Today, marketers are already achieving remarkable results - building their own data dashboards, creating agents that compress multi-day processes, and authoring tools that accelerate workflows. • Prepare marketers for an agentic future - not just prompt writing, but designing, building, and overseeing autonomous, multi-agent workflows

title: Technical Enablement Engineer
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is the default infrastructure layer for real-time AI - the platform that gives AI the ability to see, hear, and speak. From powering voice for millions of ChatGPT users to enabling drone teleoperation at Skydio and serving as the backbone for roughly 25% of 911 emergency calls in the U.S., LiveKit handles the real-time media layer that production AI applications depend on.

Over 300,000 developers and 5,000+ companies - from leading AI labs to Fortune 500 enterprises - run production workloads on LiveKit. We've raised $181M from investors including Index Ventures, Altimeter Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and we're growing fast.

 

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Our product is deeply technical, and we sell into a brand-new category: voice AI infrastructure. As we grow our Sales team, our AEs, SDRs, and presales engineers need to understand how LiveKit works, and why real-time voice AI is hard, well enough to hold their own in a customer conversation.

We're hiring a Technical Enablement Engineer to own that. You'll build our technical training program from scratch, so ramp time doesn't depend on pulling engineers off the roadmap. You'll sit on the Sales team, report to our CRO, and have a direct line to the engineers building the product.

This is a hands-on, builder-first enablement role. You'll see the impact of your work directly in how fast new sellers ramp and how confident they are in front of customers.

You'll thrive here if you:

- are known as the go-to person for tackling tough technical problems

- can clearly explain complex technical concepts to people who aren't engineers

- are a fast learner, frequently picking up new languages and tools

The best way to impress us is to build something with LiveKit and show us how you'd teach it to someone who has never touched it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Audit what AEs, SDRs, and presales know today and where deals stall on technical gaps

- Build the core curriculum: LiveKit fundamentals, voice AI architecture, agents, and the competitive landscape

- Ship hands-on labs and sandboxes so sellers build something real, not just watch slides

- Run technical onboarding for new AEs and SDRs, and create a clear technical learning path for presales and Solutions Architects

- Certify demo and discovery readiness through hands-on exercises

- Keep technical content current with every product release, working directly with engineering and product

- Measure what matters: ramp time, time to first qualified technical conversation, assessment pass rates, and seller confidence

 

WHO YOU ARE

- A senior-level engineer or technical founder who has shipped production software

- You've taught or enabled technical content to non-engineers (sales, SEs, or customers) and have a track record to show for it

- You can explain complex technical concepts simply, to any audience

- You're a fast learner who ramps quickly on new technology

 

NICE TO HAVE

- Ex-technical founder

- Experience with voice AI, WebRTC, real-time systems, or LLM applications

- Built a curriculum, bootcamp, or certification program

- Ran SE or AE onboarding at a dev-tools or infrastructure company

 

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

- An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible vacation policy

 

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

This role partners with ASC Development Leaders, regional and account sales teams, product specialists, finance, Healthcare Financial Services, service, legal, compliance, operations, and other stakeholders to translate customer requirements into coordinated, customer-centered, financially sound, and executable multi-modality solutions. The Solutions Architect owns the development of integrated equipment and service bundles, configurations, quotes, financing pathways, deal economics, approval materials, and commercial execution plans while supporting a consistent experience from discovery through booked order and implementation handoff. Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
Solution Design and Configuration

• Partner with the ASC Development Leader and commercial teams to translate the customer’s clinical strategy, procedure mix, facility plan, workflow, timeline, budget, and growth objectives into a coordinated solution architecture.

• Design scalable ASC bundles across relevant GE HealthCare equipment, software, digital, service, training, and partner capabilities, balancing customer requirements, clinical workflow, standardization, implementation readiness, and commercial objectives.

• Coordinate modality inputs, technical requirements, room and infrastructure assumptions, product dependencies, compatibility considerations, and configuration decisions. Document open items, owners, risks, and required decisions.

• Develop repeatable standard configurations and modular ASC offerings that can be adapted to independent, health system, MSO, private equity, and joint-venture customer models.

Commercial and Financial Solutioning

• Build and evaluate deal economics, including equipment and service scope, pricing, margin, customer value, projected savings, financing structure, cash-flow considerations, revenue recognition inputs, risk, and expected commercial outcomes.

• Partner with Finance and Healthcare Financial Services to evaluate capital purchase, lease, financing, phased deployment, and other approved commercial structures that align with the customer’s capital strategy and GE HealthCare requirements.

• Perform horizontal pricing analysis across modalities and offerings, identify tradeoffs, and develop recommendations that improve competitiveness while maintaining pricing discipline, compliance, and profitability.

• Prepare clear financial models, scenario comparisons, approval summaries, and executive-level decision materials that simplify complex data and enable timely action.

Quoting, Governance, and Approvals

• Coordinate the development, consolidation, quality review, and submission of multi-modality quotes, proposals, single-signature packages, and supporting commercial documentation.

• Engage required stakeholders early and facilitate pricing, risk, legal, compliance, contracting, finance, and Delegation of Authority reviews. Track approvals and resolve gaps or escalations.

• Maintain strong process discipline in CRM, quoting tools, opportunity documentation, version control, assumptions, milestones, and handoffs.

• Ensure proposed solutions comply with applicable company policies, pricing governance, commercial approval requirements, contracting standards, and customer commitments.

Pursuit and Cross-Functional Execution

• Serve as the solution-development partner to the ASC Development Leader, who remains the opportunity quarterback and owner of market development, executive relationships, opportunity strategy, pipeline, forecast, and commercial outcomes.

• Lead cross-functional working sessions to align account sales, product specialists, clinical resources, service, applications, project management, installation, finance, legal, compliance, supply chain, and external partners around one solution and action plan.
